tools.name: Grok 3
tools.description: Grok 3’s lively conversational style and powerful reasoning modes let you ask for a joke and receive witty, context‑rich humor instantly, whether you need a quick one‑liner or a more elaborate punchline.
bullets: Lively chat personality generates natural‑sounding jokes on demand
Big Brain mode can craft complex, multi‑step jokes or funny stories

tools.name: Grok 2
tools.description: Grok 2 includes a dedicated Fun interaction mode and real‑time web access, making it perfect for requesting current‑trending jokes or meme‑style humor directly in the chat.
bullets: Fun mode tailors responses to be casual and jokey
Live web retrieval pulls up‑to‑date humor trends for fresh jokes

tools.name: Poe AI
tools.description: Poe AI aggregates dozens of top‑tier models, so you can pick the one that tells jokes best—whether you prefer a witty GPT‑4 style or a dry Claude humor—right from a single interface.
bullets: Switch between multiple AI models to find the funniest style
One‑click model selection lets you compare joke outputs instantly

tools.name: Mfuniko
tools.description: Mfuniko gives you a unified hub to query any of the leading LLMs for jokes, letting you choose the model that matches your humor preference while only paying for the tokens you use.
bullets: Centralized access to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc., for joke generation
Pay‑as‑you‑go pricing means you only spend on the jokes you actually request

tools.name: Hoody AI
tools.description: Hoody AI’s privacy‑first dashboard lets you ask for a joke via text or voice and instantly hear it back, while also letting you compare how different models phrase the same joke.
bullets: Voice input returns spoken jokes for hands‑free humor
Side‑by‑side model comparison shows varied comedic takes

tools.name: Blue
tools.description: Blue’s Mac‑native integration and AppVision technology can generate a joke about whatever content is on your screen, all triggered by a simple keyboard shortcut.
bullets: Hotkey activation inserts a joke without leaving your current app
Screen‑aware AI creates context‑specific jokes based on on‑screen information

tools.name: BoltAI
tools.description: BoltAI embeds AI directly into any macOS text field, so you can request a joke while drafting an email or document and have the punchline inserted instantly.
bullets: Shortcut inserts a joke directly into any Mac text field
Customizable assistant can be tuned for a specific comedic tone

tools.name: HeyPat
tools.description: HeyPat lives in your favorite messaging apps, allowing you to text “Tell me a joke” and receive a quick, witty reply without opening a separate AI platform.
bullets: Works within WhatsApp, Telegram, SMS for instant joke delivery
No app switching—just send a message and get a humorous response

tools.name: Moveo.AI
tools.description: Moveo.AI lets businesses create a friendly chatbot persona that can sprinkle light‑hearted jokes into customer conversations, adding a human touch to automated support.
bullets: No‑code bot builder can add a joke‑telling module to your support flow
Deploys across web, mobile and social channels for consistent humor

tools.name: AskLeaf
tools.description: By uploading a FAQ or knowledge base of jokes, AskLeaf transforms static humor content into an interactive chatbot that serves jokes on demand, even in multiple languages.
bullets: Upload a joke knowledge base to enable instant, conversational joke retrieval
Multilingual support delivers jokes to a global audience

tools.name: Juicy Chat AI
tools.description: JuicyChat.ai is an NSFW‑focused AI character chat platform designed for immersive, spicy, role‑play interactions. Featuring AI‑generated visuals, voice synthesis, deep memory, and persona customization, it creates personalized virtual companions for storytelling and adult-themed conversations
bullets: Multimodal interaction: Visuals
voice

tools.name: HeyHoney
tools.description: HeyHoney.ai is an AI-powered NSFW (Not Safe For Work) chatbot and virtual companion platform. It is specifically designed to provide users with an uncensored, intimate, and interactive chat experience with a virtual "sexy companion," offering everything from flirty banter to deeper connections and explicit conversations, all within a confidential and anonymous environment.
bullets: Uncensored Conversation: Provides a space for adult-themed interactions without typical content filters.
High Availability: The AI companion is accessible 24/7 for immediate interaction.

tools.name: Crush On AI
tools.description: CrushOn.AI is an AI-powered conversational platform primarily known for its unfiltered NSFW (Not Safe For Work) character AI chat experiences. It allows users to create and interact with a vast array of AI characters, from diverse categories like anime, gaming, and celebrities, to completely custom-designed companions. The platform emphasizes user freedom, emotional plausibility, and contextual richness in conversations, aiming to provide immersive and personalized AI companionship.
bullets: Unrestricted Content: The freedom from filters for NSFW content is a significant draw for users seeking uncensored interactions.
Deep Character Customization: Extensive options to define personality

tools.name: Memedesk
tools.description: MemeDeck is an innovative platform designed to turn communities into viral content creators. By leveraging AI-powered meme creation, MemeDeck allows users to generate engaging and shareable memes, particularly for crypto projects. It aims to amplify the reach and impact of memes within the digital ecosystem, making it easier for communities to participate in the memecoin revolution.
bullets: Ease of Use: AI assistance makes meme creation accessible to everyone
regardless of design skills.

tools.name: AI RoastBot
tools.description: AI RoastBot is an AI-powered platform that lets you upload images and receive personalized, humorous roasts from a variety of AI "personalities." From selfies to memes, you’ll get quick, witty, and shareable roast images featuring your picture and the AI’s burn—all delivered in a fun and respectful style.
bullets: Delivers truly fast comedic content that’s perfect for social sharing.
Varied roast styles let users choose personality or tone they enjoy.
